_doc: Enemy types (GAME_DESIGN.md: Enemies). Phase 4 has only two PLACEHOLDER test enemies; the real Aegean Shore families (Shades, Harpies, Sirens, Satyr skirmishers) replace them in Phase 10. Speeds are px/s, radius_px is the body size used to keep enemies from stacking. Placeholder elements copy the design's patterns so weaknesses can be tested: the chaser is Water (weak to Lightning, resists Fire, like Kelpies) and the swarm is Dark (weak to Holy, resists Dark, like Shades).
